cost_policy: Costs require explicit spread/slippage/depth authority. If absent, validation is blocked and no cost-adjusted edge can be claimed.
event_label_policy: Development labels include maximum favorable premium excursion, adverse excursion, close-to-close change, percentage expansion, point expansion, time to favorable maximum, and net-after-cost feasibility. Labels are not strategy thresholds.
execution_semantics: Research-only BUY evaluation. No same-candle execution is permitted; no order action or broker API is available to this runner.
missing_data_policy: Missing option identity, missing premium OHLCV, missing quote/spread/depth, or missing underlying provenance fails closed before holdout or AlgoTest claims.
overlap_policy: Independent move clusters require one instrument/session/direction cluster with a cooldown at least as large as the selected forward horizon.
timestamp_semantics: Each candidate timestamp is the close of a completed one-minute option candle. Forward outcomes begin at the next one-minute observation.
